title: Implement range numeric input visibility and vertical sizing
description: Apply the second range implementation slice: let the Elementor widget hide/show range number inputs, constrain their vertical width, and choose their vertical side placement without changing filtering semantics.
objective: Reduce the visual weight of range number inputs in vertical mode while preserving the existing min/max sync, reset, and filtering behavior.
expected_outputs: Range vertical input side placement control
CSS contract that hidden inputs do not reserve layout
Mechanical verification plus Guilherme visual QA scenario
acceptance_criteria: Existing widgets show number inputs by default for backward compatibility.
Turning number inputs off hides the input rail without breaking slider filtering.
Vertical number inputs no longer expand into a large flexible column by default.
The slice does not implement deferred custom range engine or selected track work.
Guilherme remains responsible for final visual QA in Elementor.
verification: PHP lint passes for changed PHP files.
JS syntax check passes because range sync depends on existing JS.
git diff --check passes in root and plugin.
Generated range markup exposes the expected input visibility and placement classes.

budgets.context_budget: range render, range style controls, range CSS, existing JS sync
budgets.research_budget: local source plus TASK-FC-006 and TASK-FC-018 outputs

risks: Hiding number inputs can reduce direct keyboard entry even though native sliders remain keyboard accessible.
Vertical placement still needs Guilherme's visual judgment across Elementor breakpoints.
